# crosswork_login_banner (Resource)

This resource can manage the pre-login disclaimer of the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_login_banner" "example" {
  show_message = true
  user_ack     = false
  message      = "Authorized use only"
  icon         = "BANNER_ICON_IMPORTANT"
  title        = "Notice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `icon` (String) Icon of the disclaimer
  - Choices: `BANNER_ICON_INFO`, `BANNER_ICON_IMPORTANT`, `BANNER_ICON_CRITICAL`
  - Default value: `BANNER_ICON_INFO`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `message` (String) Text of the disclaimer
  - Default value: `Welcome to Cisco Crosswork. Logging into the system means that you acknowledge and agree to comply with Cisco Crosswork terms and conditions.`
- `show_message` (Boolean) Show the disclaimer before the login
  - Default value: `false`
- `title` (String) Title of the disclaimer
  - Default value: `Crosswork Legal Disclaimer`
- `user_ack` (Boolean) Ask the user to acknowledge the disclaimer. The controller reads it as false whenever `show_message` is false
  - Default value: `false`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_login_banner.example "login_banner"
```
